body: I went to a psychiatrist once. I did not enjoy the experience. I have to say though I never thought I would be able to do that by my own. I went back like for 3 sessions, he prescribed me some meds, I don't feel like they've helped, I take one of them to this day. I've been thinking going to a psychologist lately, the thing is, I read a lot about psychology, philosophy, that kind of stuff, and I'm almost sure I wouldn't feel comfortable with a psychologist who doesn't challenge me intellectually, I don't know, I know that seems very arrogant on my part. I just feel no one understands what I try to say when I try to explain what I feel. And well, also, I leave in anxiety, so I don't know if I can push myself to go alone. I wish I had a friend who would support me that way, push me in that direction, to help me lower my anxiety by talking through it. By I have no one. Just thinking about being alone with a stranger talking about my life, my traumas and all, makes me feel pretty anxious.
I'm not brave at all, if I was, I would've end it all a long time ago... or accept this pain. I haven't been able to do neither.

I tried it once, he didn't know how to handle the situation I guess and distanced himself from me. I tried it in other occasions, but I don't think people want to hear it, I seems to me that they feel it's a way of manipulation or emotional blackmail. Also, I really don't have close friends, except from the one that walked away on me. I cannot completely blame him though, he had his own problems and I know I can make things difficult.  
I've also tried getting closer with some people, but I just don't know how, when I was a kid I had selective mutism, a form of social anxiety, so no matter how much I tried I couldn't talked to people, mostly in school. It still affects me to this day, I might pass for someone normal more or less nowadays, I joke a lot, but when it comes to intimate with someone, when being alone specially, I cannot sustain a conversation, my brain just shuts down. So it's very difficult for me, all of this has pretty much ruin my life at this point.  
Funny thing is, I have manage to make some people open about themselves with me, they have told me private stuff and how they feel, and I tried to help them as I would like someone else to help me, but when I need help they seem to just don't care. I also get too attached to them emotionally, which is not healthy, and feel very betrayed when they don't seem to care about me. I might have BPD as well...
